items.item_text: Certified Radiologic Technologist (CRT) CA state licensure required.
Bachelor's degree required, or a combination of education and/or additional imaging-related experience may be substituted in lieu of the degree.
Minimum of five (5) years of diagnostic imaging experience required.
Minimum of three (3) years experience managing/supervising diagnostic imaging services required.
As our Director of Diagnostic Radiology, you will oversee Imaging Services for Sierra Nevada Memorial Hospital, comprised of Diagnostic Radiology, MRI, Ultrasound, and Nuclear Medicine.

Every day, you will strive to lead and inspire upward of 60 staff members working in a fast paced environment, and to empower the Manager Imaging Services and other front line leaders to drive day to day clinical operations while promoting quality practices and a culture of teamwork. This will help allow you to focus on big-picture strategy and growth, ongoing review of services, and other key initiatives such as patient experience.

To be successful in this role, you will need to be an experienced Radiology Tech, who has a demonstrated track record of managing Imaging Services for a mid-large sized acute care Hospital. If that sounds like you, come leverage your experience to help improve upon and grow our services to better serve our community!
We are offering relocation assistance to all hires who meet relocation eligibility requirements.

Additional incentives for this position include an annual performance-based bonus program, annual employer-funded retirement contribution (no employee contribution required), no-cost medical coverage for the employee, and a Flexible Time Away program.
